description: Poll publish state after deploy (queued, checking, promoting, live, failed). queued = waiting for a check runner (queuePosition shows your place); wait recommendedPollSeconds between polls. Omit deployment_id for the latest. Use get_checks_results for Lighthouse/a11y scores and get_preview_url once live. Read-only; do not retry deploy while queued, checking, or promoting.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment UUID. Omit to use the project's latest deployment.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.
